modeling_decisions: Original replacement sheet genuinely inspected; retain paired valves, forward eyes, swimming flaps, abdomen and fork. Discard AI texture and apparent ring count inconsistencies. Tail rami are unsegmented tapering forks rather than AI jointed third antenna-like structures. Straight dorsal hinge and suboval valve outlines; two closed thickened domed shells with open ventral separation reveal flattened flaps. No claws or walking legs, no shrimp tail fan. Source says swimming; root is floor-centered minimum display support extent, not assertion animal walks.
